title: Unique polynomial lifts annihilating a conormal complement
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, S an R-algebra, and G a family of R-algebra generators of S indexed by a set T [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put P=R[x_t:t in T], let p:P to S be the induced surjection, and let J=ker(p). Let K be an ideal of P contained in J. Write d:J/J^2 to S tensor_P Omega_{P/R} for the conormal differential, g mod J^2 maps to 1 tensor dg [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Suppose every element of S tensor_P Omega_{P/R} is d(g mod J^2) for some g in K, and that g in K with d(g mod J^2)=0 implies g in J^2. For every commutative R-algebra A, square-zero ideal I of A and R-algebra map a:S to A/I, there is a unique R-algebra map beta:P to A such that q composed with beta equals a composed with p and beta(K)=0, where q:A to A/I is the quotient map.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 04EB (lemma-universal-thickening), polynomial correction argument, from choosing beta to the final sentence. The same argument uses K/(K intersection J^2), so it does not need J^2 contained in K.

proof.text: Choose a lift z_t in A of a(G.val t) for each variable using surjectivity of q. Let beta = MvPolynomial.aeval z. Polynomial extensionality proves q composed with beta equals a composed with p.

The reduction equation gives beta(J) contained in I. Taking ideal squares gives beta(J^2) contained in I^2 = 0. Equip A with its P-algebra structure via beta and form the P-linear obstruction b:K to I, g maps to beta(g). Let t:K to S tensor_P Omega_{P/R} send g to 1 tensor dg. The first hypothesis makes t surjective; the second, combined with beta(J^2)=0, makes b zero on ker t. Descend b through K/ker t and use Mathlib LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective to obtain l with l(t(g))=b(g).

Compose -l with omega maps to 1 tensor omega and the universal R-derivation on P. This gives a derivation D:P to I with D(g)=-beta(g) for g in K. Mathlib liftOfDerivationToSquareZero gives betaPrime = D + beta, an R-algebra map since I^2=0. Its quotient reduction is unchanged and betaPrime(g)=0 for g in K.

For two such lifts betaOne and betaTwo, let P act on A through betaTwo. Mathlib derivationToSquareZeroOfLift gives the difference derivation D:P to I. Since I^2=0, Module.IsTorsionBySet.module equips I with an A/I action and hence an S action through a; the common reduction equation verifies compatibility with the P action. Extend D.liftKaehlerDifferential to an S-linear map F:S tensor_P Omega_{P/R} to I. It takes 1 tensor dg to D(g). For every w choose g in K with t(g)=w. Both lifts vanish on g, so D(g)=0 and F(w)=0. Therefore D(x)=F(1 tensor dx)=0 for all x, and the lifts are equal.

mathlib_searches.query: Correct a lift of a polynomial algebra through a square zero ideal by a derivation to annihilate a conormal complement
Polynomial algebra lifts into a square zero extension can be uniquely corrected to vanish on an ideal when its conormal differential is bijective modulo the square of the presentation kernel

theorem conormalComplement_polynomial_lift
    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {ι : Type u} (G : Generators R S ι) (K : Ideal G.Ring)
    (hK : K ≤ G.toExtension.ker)
    (hsurj : ∀ w : G.toExtension.CotangentSpace,
      ∃ x : G.toExtension.ker, x.val ∈ K ∧
        G.toExtension.cotangentComplex (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) = w)
    (hinj : ∀ x : G.toExtension.ker, x.val ∈ K →
      G.toExtension.cotangentComplex (Extension.Cotangent.mk x) = 0 →
        x.val ∈ G.toExtension.ker ^ 2)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (a : S →ₐ[R] A ⧸ I) :
    ∃! β : G.Ring →ₐ[R] A,
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp β = a.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R G.Ring S) ∧
        ∀ x : G.Ring, x ∈ K → β x = 0
